findings.text: section rows appended to deps at reckon/mcp.py:942-952 are folded into the typed summary view's blocking list through reckon/mcp.py:1360 into mcp_views._blocking -> lifecycle.unresolved_dependencies (reckon/mcp_views.py:1916), which reads only found and status, so a plan whose sole wait is one section still reports an unresolved plan-level dependency on the MCP surface while the roadmap keeps it ready (probe at head: blocking [{"ref": "plan-b#s3", "found": true, "status": ""}]) — the plan-level veto this feature removes, reasserted on the read surface with no test covering it.

a whole-blob malformation of plan-section-depends-on (invalid JSON, or valid JSON that is not an object) returns None with no finding, silently erasing every declared wait, where the entry-level malformation beside it is refused by name in the same change and the neighbouring plan-section-declarations meta warns at reckon/_plan_html.py:451 — so a single typo at the blob level suspends section gating on the scheduling surface with no signal.
